children: Parabolic Technologies entered into an underwriting agreement with Aegis Capital for a public offering priced at $13.5 million, consisting of units with common stock or pre-funded warrants and accompanying warrants. The warrants are immediately exercisable, have a five-year term, and include potential exercise-price resets and a cashless exercise option. The company received approximately $5.512 million in net proceeds for working capital, general corporate purposes and debt repayment.
